metadata.change_reason: Domain modeling and core abstractions quality standard: 100% PRD entity coverage, clear aggregate root boundaries, and complete Trait/Interface abstractions

spec.name: Domain Modeling & Core Abstractions Quality Standard
spec.objective: Ensure domain models are rigorously derived from PRD business requirements, achieving 100% coverage of all entities and concepts with clear aggregate root boundaries and complete Trait/Interface abstractions
principles: 100% PRD Entity Coverage: Illustrative-only entity sets are strictly prohibited; must comprehensively cover all business nouns, entities, and value objects in the PRD
High-Cohesion Aggregate Boundaries: Explicitly define aggregate root lifecycle boundaries and cross-aggregate communication constraints
Complete Core Trait Abstractions: Define method signatures, purity, and error models for all cross-module traits and interfaces
Zero Placeholders: Any TBD, To Be Determined, or unconfirmed placeholders are strictly prohibited

review_dimensions.name: PRD Entity Full Coverage Rate
review_dimensions.description: Whether 100% of PRD business entities and concepts are covered

review_dimensions.name: Aggregate Root & Consistency Boundary Clarity
review_dimensions.description: Whether aggregate roots and transactional consistency boundaries are rigorously defined

review_dimensions.name: Core Trait / Interface Abstraction Rigor
review_dimensions.description: Whether core interface method signatures possess strong typing constraints and side-effect specifications

review_dimensions.name: Domain Event Stream Completeness
review_dimensions.description: Whether domain event definitions and trigger conditions are explicit and complete
